dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Thanks to your aid and support, Ogura Textiles & Kimonos has weathered the worst of this storm."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Word is that the Kanjou Commission is currently negotiating with Liyue's mercantile guilds and that the import of silks and ready-to-wear clothes will soon resume..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Once my brother returns from his duties, we shall refurbish this store together."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Once again, I, Ogura Mio, would like to thank all our neighbors and friends for lending a helping hand. I will find a way to repay you all in turn."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "No, no, it was what we should've done. You're too polite, Miss Ogura!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Well, the war's over in any case, so don't mind if I engage your services again the next time I need a custom-made kimono!"
